newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.Africa province to get new airport by end-1998.
newsitem.headline: S.Africa province to get new airport by end-1998.

text.p: Construction of a 225 million rand airport near Hazyview in South Africa's eastern Mpumulanga province will start later this year.

The airport should be commissioned towards the end of 1998 and is being developed by a consortium consisting of Germany's Daimler Benz Aerospace, local group Nyala Developments and black-owned contracting firm Nyezi Roads.

Isak Fick, chief executive officer of Nyala, told Reuters on Thursday the consortium, called the Kruger Park International Airport Development Co, had also set up a working relationship with construction firm Concor Ltd.
Fick said the airport, on the border of South Africa's largest game reserve, the Kruger National Park, would also serve as a hub for exporting fresh fruit from the surrounding region.
"We would love to be known as an airport that imports tourists and exports fruit," Fick said.
When operations at Hazyview begin, commercial air traffic at an airport at Skukuza inside the Kruger Park would cease, Fick said.
